{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.50

|gr1= Environment

|descr= Changes the lightnings value smoothly during the given time (in seconds). A time of zero means there will be an immediate change.<br><br>
'''NOTE''': This command will have no effect (even though the value of [[lightnings]] changes) unless {{hl|Manual Override}} option is selected in the editor in the Intel, which is normally off.<br><br>
[[File:setLightnings.jpg|left|600px]]

|s1= time [[setLightnings]] value

|p1= time: [[Number]]

|p2= value: [[Number]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>1800 setLightnings 0.7;</sqf>
